notes: This framework analyzes software issue reports to find those that are inducing architectural smells. Based on the analysis, it trains models that can classify unseen issues based on title and description, using three complementary machine learning approaches: traditional ML, RoBERTa fine-tuning, and zero-shot LLM classification. The approach and evaluation are detailed in our paper: Architecture in the Cradle: Early Prevention of Architectural Decay with ArchGuard
